description: ClustalW 2.1's multiple alignment of DNA (clustalw -TYPE=DNA -ALIGN), ported step by step and verified row-for-row against the installed clustalw 2.1: pairwise distances (distance='clustalw' = the full affine Smith-Waterman-Gotoh stage, 'clustalw-quick' = the fast k-tuple stage of -QUICKTREE with ktuple / window / topDiagonals / pairGap), ClustalW's neighbour-joining guide tree (rooted by Tree::reRoot), sequence weights derived from the tree branch lengths (Thompson, Higgins & Gibson 1994; noWeights = equal weights), delayed divergent sequences (maxDiv, default 30: sequences with at most that percent identity to every other sequence are aligned last), and profile-profile alignment with position-specific gap penalties (positions that already hold gaps get a reduced opening penalty and half the extension penalty, end gaps are free) on the IUB weight matrix shifted to non-negative scores (negative = keep it signed) with transitions weighted by transitionWeight (clustalw -TRANSWEIGHT, default 0.5) and Myers-Miller linear-space alignment. gapOpen / gapExtend are ClustalW's -GAPOPEN 15 / -GAPEXT 6.66 (the DNA residue-specific, hydrophilic and gap-separation penalties of clustalw are protein-only). Rows are returned in input order. match / mismatch / scoreGapOpen / scoreGapExtend define only the reported totalScore (natural affine sum of pairs, Altschul 1989).

sequences.description: DNA sequences to align (at least one; A, C, G, T).

gapOpen.description: ClustalW -GAPOPEN: gap-opening penalty of the profile alignment (default 15; a penalty, positive).

gapExtend.description: ClustalW -GAPEXT: gap-extension penalty of the profile alignment (default 6.66).

distance.description: Pairwise stage that gives the guide-tree distances: 'clustalw' (default; full DP, clustalw -ALIGN) or 'clustalw-quick' (fast k-tuple mode, clustalw -QUICKTREE).

pwGapOpen.description: ClustalW -PWGAPOPEN: pairwise gap-opening penalty of the full pairwise stage (default 15).

pwGapExtend.description: ClustalW -PWGAPEXT: pairwise gap-extension penalty of the full pairwise stage (default 6.66).

transitionWeight.description: ClustalW -TRANSWEIGHT: weight of transitions (A-G, C-T/U) in the profile matrix (default 0.5; 0 = as mismatches, 1 = as matches).

maxDiv.description: ClustalW -MAXDIV (default 30): a sequence whose highest percent identity to any other sequence is at most this value is delayed (aligned last, after the rest).

negative.description: ClustalW -NEGATIVE: keep the substitution matrix signed instead of shifting it to non-negative scores.

ktuple.description: distance='clustalw-quick' only: k-tuple (word) size, 1-4 for DNA (clustalw -KTUPLE, default 2).

window.description: distance='clustalw-quick' only: diagonals scanned around each top diagonal (clustalw -WINDOW, default 4).

topDiagonals.description: distance='clustalw-quick' only: number of best diagonals used (clustalw -TOPDIAGS, default 4).

pairGap.description: distance='clustalw-quick' only: gap penalty of the fragment chain (clustalw -PAIRGAP; default 5, or ktuple + 4 when ktuple is given, as the clustalw command line does).

match.description: Score for matching base in the reported totalScore only.

mismatch.description: Score for mismatching base in the reported totalScore only.

scoreGapOpen.description: Gap-open score of the reported totalScore only (negative = penalty).

scoreGapExtend.description: Gap-extend score of the reported totalScore only (negative = penalty).

alignedSequences.description: The aligned rows of the MSA (input order).

consensus.description: Majority-vote consensus of the aligned rows (gaps vote; a nucleotide beats a gap on ties).

totalScore.description: Natural affine sum-of-pairs score of the alignment under match / mismatch / scoreGapOpen / scoreGapExtend (ClustalW itself reports no such score).

errors.message: gapOpen, gapExtend, pwGapOpen, pwGapExtend, transitionWeight must be non-negative; distance must be clustalw or clustalw-quick
